The Punjab and Haryana High Court is scrutinizing his assertions regarding the resolution of issues related to the state's appeal in the Supreme Court. Previously, the court ordered the government to settle overdue dearness allowance for both employees and pensioners.

candidates.title: Drones strike two vessels in Bulgaria's economic zone; one ship sinks
candidates.excerpt: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev revealed that drones targeted two commercial ships in Bulgaria's Exclusive Economic Zone, leading to alarming consequences. The Togo-flagged Alfa Watan sank after critical damage, while the Able vessel from Palau caught fire. Remarkably, a Bulgarian ferry was able to rescue all 18 crew members, with two suffering serious injuries.

candidates.title: Married in Rajouri, case filed in Jammu: why the high court let the divorce suit stay
candidates.excerpt: A Jammu and Kashmir high court addressed the territorial jurisdiction of divorce suits amid allegations of cruelty. The wife's application for divorce was initially challenged by her husband based on the location of their marriage. The court found that part of the cause of action arose within its jurisdiction due to claims of cruelty. The husband's petition to transfer the case was dismissed for lacking merit.
